This covers IT operations, enterprise systems, cybersecurity, data governance, artificial intelligence (AI), digital innovation, and business continuity. The position drives the strategic use, governance, and continuous improvement of SCIDN’s enterprise technology ecosystem. This includes enterprise resource planning (ERP), customer relationship management (CRM), collaboration and productivity platforms, data and analytics solutions, and other digital capabilities. The goal is technology investments that deliver business value, support organizational KPIs, and make SCIDN data-driven and future-ready. Advise the Senior Management Team (SMT) and relevant function leads on technology and digital transformation priorities. Identify opportunities to use technology, automation, digital innovation, data, and AI to improve organizational performance and impact. Develop and maintain technology roadmaps and architecture principles so that technology investments are scalable, sustainable, cost-effective, and in line with organizational strategy. Technology & Digital Governance Establish and strengthen governance frameworks, policies, standards, and procedures covering IT operations, enterprise systems, cybersecurity, data, AI, and digital innovation. Manage technology risks and drive continuous improvement in security, compliance, and service delivery. Ensure compliance with Save the Children standards, donor requirements, local regulations, and industry best practice. Work with business owners to improve processes, increase automation, strengthen system integration, and enhance user experience, so that technology solutions support organizational objectives and operational needs. Data, Analytics and Artificial Intelligence Strengthen data governance and promote effective use of organizational data for planning, performance management, decision-making, and reporting. Establish and promote data lifecycle management practices covering classification, retention, archiving, storage optimization, accessibility, and disposal, in line with organizational, legal, and regulatory requirements. Advise on the technology platforms, infrastructure, and digital capabilities needed for effective data governance, information management, analytics, and reporting. Ensure the right data architecture, integration, and technology solutions are in place to provide trusted, secure, and accessible organizational data. Identify and implement practical, responsible AI solutions that improve productivity, efficiency, and organizational learning. Strengthen cybersecurity through proactive risk management, user awareness, incident response, and business continuity planning. Monitor technology service performance and drive continuous improvement. Manage technology budgets and procurement, making sure investments deliver value for money and support organizational priorities. Oversee vendors, consultants, implementation partners, managed service providers, and software providers, ensuring performance, contract compliance, cost optimization, and alignment with organizational objectives. Ensure technology systems and services support emergency preparedness and humanitarian response. Provide technology leadership and operational support during emergency responses as required. People Leadership and Organizational Capability Lead, coach, and develop the Technology & Digital team to deliver high-quality services and strategic outcomes. Promote digital literacy, technology adoption, innovation, and change management across the organization. Build a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and service excellence.
